ValidationRule.description: If the Primary Phone picklist value is Home Phone, the Home Phone field must be populated. The same applies for Mobile Phone and Work Phone.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
( ISPICKVAL( Primary_Phone__c , "Home Phone") && ISBLANK( HomePhone ) || ISPICKVAL( Primary_Phone__c , "Mobile Phone") && ISBLANK( MobilePhone ) || ISPICKVAL( Primary_Phone__c , "Work Phone") && (ISBLANK( OtherPhone )) ) &&
$Profile.Name != 'System Administrator'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The phone number you have selected to be the Primary Phone is not populated. Please enter a value in that phone field or select a different value.
